name: Retina Paints Limited
summary: Retina Paints Limited is a specialist in decorative coatings, offering a wide array of products such as emulsions, distempers, primers, spray plasters, and their proprietary Retina wall finishes. Their environmentally friendly, water-based paint solutions are suitable for application in both residential properties and commercial establishments. Key product lines within their extensive portfolio include Expo Ultimax, Expo Exterior emulsion, Glow Premium, Glow Exterior emulsion, X-Gen cement primer, and Eco-Exterior cement primer. The company commenced operations on November 1, 2010, and maintains its principal office in Hyderabad, India.
